correctness.rationale: For each partition of [n] into k non-adjacency blocks of sizes s_i, even 2-by-2 orientation parity between blocks of sizes r,s is equivalent to X_uv=ρ_u+γ_v in F₂. Global simultaneous bit flip identifies exactly two parameter choices, giving 2^(r+s-1) distinct cross matrices. Choices across distinct block pairs are independent; exponent ∑(s_i+s_j-1)=(k-1)n-binomial(k,2), and summing S(n,k) proves a_n. Ultrahomogeneity identifies finite labeled induced structures with injective tuple orbits, and repetition partition yields b_n=∑S(n,r)a_r. For j=n-k the exponent equals binomial(n,2)-binomial(j+1,2). Bounding S(n,n-j) by binomial(binomial(n,2),j) yields log₂ correction ≤2(log₂n)^2+O(log n); j≈2log₂n disjoint pairs give matching lower 2(log₂n)^2-O(log n loglog n). The supplied n≤6 exhaustive finite checker checks small cases only; the analytic count proves all n.
